incident_text: A brick building partly collapsed after the earthquake. Bricks are lying across the street.

result.scene_summary: A damaged brick building with collapsed sections and debris at its base, surrounded by traffic cones and temporary barriers. In the background, other buildings and a distant skyscraper are visible.

observations.description: A multi-story brick building with significant damage to its upper floors, exposed beams, and collapsed sections.
A street lamp and traffic signal pole in the foreground, with a green awning partially torn off.
A pile of rubble and bricks at the base of the damaged building.
A red vehicle is visible in the distance on the right side of the street.
Trees and greenery are visible in the distant background.
A 'No S' sign is visible on the ground among the debris.

not_determinable: extent of damage to surrounding infrastructure
